response.overview: After a torrential rain, two people who should have parted ways at dawn found themselves trapped in the same room by a sudden lockdown. One was a writer—cold, obsessive about cleanliness, as if wrapped in a layer of plastic film; the other, a young boy—light, ardent, a trespasser into his life. The fourteen days of waiting were pried open by the sound of rain, the plastic film, the unread pages of a book, and an unexpected test result. The names that had been deleted, the fears that had been hidden, the old loves woven into novels—slowly rose from the depths of the room.
response.title: Between Polar Glasses
